instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved this position for my wet sock: beside your dinner. It came through your puddle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you take it away? It's only water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Removal is pending. You may explain why only water was worth leaving where I would step.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wipe the floor. Just move the sock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Floor repair is approved. Add 'I'm sorry' and I'll remove the sock. You may finish dinner without looking at what my foot went through.

beats.text: I've approved a review of my evening. These circles are the buses I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Compensation is declined. An apology will secure immediate clearance. Say you're sorry and I'll retire the entire exhibition.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And the cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're better at it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then this is your training opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you show me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. First, accept the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I took your bins out once during your holiday. I didn't volunteer for life. Tonight's yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbours already send you the reminders.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll introduce you in the group as their permanent bin contact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in it until I know what I'm doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay until you send 'I'll handle Thursday.' They can welcome you while I leave.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved a final check of tomorrow's hike. Ridge or river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ridge. We changed because the river path flooded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ridge is confirmed. You may remind the party where we're meeting; tell me your exact wording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've asked twice. Have you forgotten your own itinerary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I authorize a trial briefing. Treat me as a new arrival; I'll assess whether your instructions get me to the right meeting place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've authorized a final check of Mum's birthday invitations. What time did we settle on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven, in the private room. Can I check them before you send?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your check is approved. Start by saying the restaurant name exactly as it appears.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't have your invitation. You haven't sent me anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I approve the booking confirmation as your proof copy. Read it aloud; I'll type from you so no unauthorized spelling creeps in.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved you to support my bin proposal at the house meeting. Alex takes Thursday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I see the new rota? The old one says you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The old rota is superseded. You're authorized to refer to our new conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We had a new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for clarification is granted. We're having it now. You may confirm that I explained the change to you personally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may support my account to the manager: I agreed to mornings, not evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you ask someone who attended the meeting? I wasn't there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your impartiality is approved. You have no competing recollection to confuse the issue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not lying for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Silence is permitted. You may stand beside me and look thoughtfully unsurprised while I explain. Would that form of support meet your objection?
